display_name: Penal Code 1871 — the whole Code, to the charge generator's contract
versions_encoded: Penal Code 1871 as consolidated on Singapore Statutes Online, "Current version as at 09 Sep 2026" (registers/source-bundle/PC1871.txt)
scope: Every section in the Code's table of contents has a row in a notes/<group>-coverage.md table. Taking each section's best disposition: 443 encoded, 29 inert (definitions and text that is not a rule), 72 repealed, 42 deferred for time. Deferred: ss 301, 304B, 304C, 308A, 310, 311, 314, 315, 316, 335A; and ss 372, 373, 373A, 376B-376H, 377, 377B, 377BB-377BO, 377C. 344 punishing provisions each have a facts record, a defining predicate, `offence under s N` and `charge under s N` returning a Charge that refuses with the missing elements when not made out (CPC 2010 s 123(5)). Chapters 4 and 4A create no offence and export `exception under s N` ladders instead. Illustrations are the main source of tests. 174 forks are registered in notes/<group>-forks.md.
not_reviewed: No lawyer has read this row against the source. No independent test pass has been run: every test was written by the agent that wrote the code it tests. It is not a cleanroom: the encoders read the `legalese` row as the pattern for the charge generator's contract. One reading was ruled by Meng Wong on 2026-09-26: "above 18 years of age" means 18 or older.

pc-general-part-tests.l4.why: Findings about the Code, left red on purpose: s 118's Illustration treats gang-robbery as punishable with death or life imprisonment, which s 395 no longer provides (fork GP-14); s 512(4)'s Illustration treats attempted robbery under s 512, where s 393 now makes express provision (fork GP-10).
